reviewed_by: Codex manual comparison of original E5 extraction texts with the frozen gold
policy: Gold labels are unchanged. These overrides credit semantically equivalent abbreviations, pronouns and a fact split across two evidence items. Missing numbers or Grade D are not inferred.

rationale.original/sol/1/G10: The 60–69 and 70–79 lifetime model findings are explicitly extracted as two separate items.
rationale.original/sonnet/1/G1: The sentence states initiation at 60+, then says recommends against it (Grade D); the pronoun has an explicit antecedent.
rationale.original/sonnet/*/G5: CV mortality abbreviates cardiovascular mortality; each item explicitly says no significant effect.
rationale.not_credited: Sol omits Grade D in all original samples. Sonnet sample 3 does not retain the ischemic-stroke lower CI bound required by G4.
